# Upstream baseline provenance

- Transolver++: https://github.com/thuml/Transolver_plus
  - commit `d5a23bc734a0ebac56384cf72049a26af9673452`
  - license: MIT
- MoNo: https://github.com/zijiangyang1998/Multiscale-Neural-Operator
  - commit `60d086a45d4929769796fb3b2dfacc6680528f3b`
  - license: Apache-2.0

The matched Tiny wrappers preserve the defining mechanisms while using the
same 4096-node AirfRANS protocol, width 64, CUDA-only execution, and identical
train/validation/test data as RAPTOR. They are adaptations, not claimed as the
authors' full published configurations.
